As Insperity Com (NSP) Stock Price Rose, First National Bank Of Hutchinson Increased Stake by $336,870; Oxbow Advisors Has Decreased Its Holding in Discovery Communications C (DISCA) by $1.09 Million
May 15, 2018 - By Richard Conner
First National Bank Of Hutchinson increased its stake in Insperity Inc Com (NSP) by 97.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. First National Bank Of Hutchinson bought 5,910 shares as the company’s stock rose 19.72% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 11,957 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $686,000, up from 6,047 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First National Bank Of Hutchinson who had been investing in Insperity Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.67B market cap company. The stock increased 0.46% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $87.3. About 39,067 shares traded. Insperity, Inc. (NYSE:NSP) has risen 61.54% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 49.99% the S&P500.
Oxbow Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Discovery Communications Inc C (DISCA) by 43.72% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oxbow Advisors Llc sold 49,735 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.64% with the market. The institutional investor held 64,015 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.43 million, down from 113,750 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oxbow Advisors Llc who had been investing in Discovery Communications Inc C for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $17.06 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:DISCA) has declined 21.53% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.08% the S&P500.
